description: Implementation of a service class for reading provisioning entries and related data in the Fineract accounting provisioning module. Contains methods for retrieving provisioning data, entries, and associated details, with multiple internal mappers and query builders.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntriesReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing provisioning entry reading functionalities, including data retrieval and mapping.

classes.name: LoanProductProvisioningEntryMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL result set to LoanProductProvisioningEntryData for loan provisioning entries.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntryDataMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL result set to ProvisioningEntryData for provisioning entries.

classes.name: LoanProductProvisioningEntryRowMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL result set to LoanProductProvisioningEntryData for detailed provisioning entries.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntryDataMapperWithSumReserved
classes.description: Maps SQL result set to ProvisioningEntryData including sum of reserved amounts.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntryIdDateRowMapper
classes.description: Maps SQL result set to ProvisioningEntryData for retrieving latest provisioning ID and date.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductsProvisioningData
methods.description: Retrieves provisioning data for loan products as of a specific date.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningEntryData
methods.description: Retrieves provisioning entry data by entry ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllProvisioningEntries
methods.description: Retrieves paginated list of all provisioning entries with optional offset and limit.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningEntryData
methods.description: Retrieves provisioning entry data by creation date string.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningEntryDataByCriteriaId
methods.description: Retrieves provisioning data by criteria ID, including associated provisioning entries.

methods.name: retrieveExistingProvisioningIdDateWithJournals
methods.description: Retrieves the latest provisioning ID and date where journal entries exist.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningEntries
methods.description: Retrieves paginated provisioning entries based on search parameters.
